The [[human]] '''Liana Merian''' served as an [[aide]] in the [[Alderaanian delegation|delegation]] representing the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo|Naboo Crisis]]<ref name="TVE" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> Merian served alongside fellow aides [[Agrippa Aldrete]] and [[Stonroy Soma]]<ref name="TVE" /> under [[Alderaanian]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Antilles]].<ref name="HC34">{{HelmetCollectionCite|34|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> Merian had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]] worn in buns on either side of their head with an [[Clothing|outfit]] including a white dress.<ref name="TVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Liana Merian was a character created to appear in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="Deleted">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga|scene=Vote of No Confidence}}</ref> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character appeared in a scene filmed on B Stage at [[Leavesden Studios]] [[June 30]], [[1997]],<ref name="Filming">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> but it was cut from the final release of the film. In the scene, Merian is sat in a [[repulsorpod]] with Soma, Aldrete, and Antilles in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] when [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] calls for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]. Antilles, who was named [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] during production, then stands and seconds the motion.<ref name="Deleted" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first mentioned in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TVE" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Liana Merian/Legends|Merian]] was first mentioned and named in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released on [[May 26]], 1999.<ref name="Amazon">{{CollectorCite|6|Books with Bite}}</ref>
